rationale: FindSkia links a copy of Skia's libskunicode_icu.a whose embedded ICU data keeps only the items Pulp's linked ICU code reads (break-iterator rules and dictionaries, normalization, properties, converter aliases, locale resolution); the Skia/Dawn render backends, design-import, Chromium and packaging authority are unchanged and no authority moves. In the same range, the CoreGraphics canvas and the no-Skia TextShaper resolve fonts through one CoreText face registry (bundled fonts and register_font faces) instead of CTFontCreateWithName, which substituted Helvetica for the bundled Inter; paint and measurement change for CPU-painted text only. Break-boundary, footprint and text-metric tests hold both changes.
